script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: UNKNOWN

FADE IN:

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - NIGHT

The facility is dimly lit. DR. MILLER, a brilliant yet eccentric scientist, works at a large computer terminal. He's absorbed in his research, wearing thick glasses and a lab coat.

DR. MILLER
(mumbles to himself)
Just a little more...

Suddenly, an alarm blares. Dr. Miller looks up, worried.

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Miller hurries through the lab, eyes darting from monitor to monitor. He comes across a sleeping ELLA, a young woman with long, curly hair.

DR. MILLER
(whispers)
Ella, we have a problem. You need to wake up.

Ella's eyes open slowly. She looks around, confused.

ELLA
What's wrong, Dr. Miller?

DR. MILLER
Our experiment, the one that grants people the ability to change their physical appearance at will, has malfunctioned. I need your help to shut it down.

EXT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - NIGHT

As they rush through the facility, they encounter several unidentified individuals with drastically altered appearances. Some have extra limbs, others have eyes in the wrong places, and yet others have melted features.

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - NIGHT

They finally reach the experiment's control room. Ella hesitates, staring at the chaotic machine before them.

ELLA
I don't know if I can do this, Dr. Miller. This machine... it's beyond anything I've ever seen before.

DR. MILLER
(smiling reassuringly)
You've faced much harder challenges in your life, Ella. You've got this.

Ella takes a deep breath and approaches the machine. As she begins to make adjustments, Dr. Miller watches in awe, realizing that she has a natural affinity for the technology.

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - DAY

The next morning, Ella wakes up in her own bed at home. She looks around, confused. Dr. Miller enters the room, wearing a concerned expression.

DR. MILLER
Ella, you did it. The experiment is under control, but at a great cost. You've absorbed the machine's essence, and now you have the ability to change your own appearance.

ELLA
(excitedly)
Really? But how?

DR. MILLER
It's not clear yet. We'll need to study this further, but for now, I suggest we keep your ability a secret. The world isn't ready for something like this.

EXT. CITY STREETS - DAY

As Ella goes about her daily life, she experiments with her new ability, trying on various appearances to see how they feel. She becomes increasingly fascinated by the concept of identity and the freedom that comes with being able to change her appearance at will.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Ella sits in a coffee shop, sipping her drink and watching the world go by. She transforms into a striking blonde woman, catching the attention of the other patrons.

BLONDE ELLA
(smiling to herself)
This is fascinating. But who am I really when I'm not me?

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - NIGHT

As Ella continues to grapple with her new identity, she begins to feel a strange connection to the machine. She senses that it's reaching out to her, trying to communicate something.

DR. MILLER
(concerned)
Ella, what's wrong?

ELLA
(frantically)
Dr. Miller, the machine... it's trying to tell me something. I think it wants to communicate.

DR. MILLER
(skeptical)
That's impossible. Machines can't communicate in that way.

ELLA
(insistent)
But I can feel it, Dr. Miller. It's pleading for help.

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - DAY

Ella and Dr. Miller work together to decipher the machine's messages, which are conveyed through subtle changes in the laboratory environment. They discover that the machine is not just a tool, but a living being that has been trapped within the confines of its own creation.

INT. REMOTE RESEARCH FACILITY - LAB - NIGHT

With Dr. Miller's help, Ella manages to free the machine from its physical confines. It transforms into a beautiful, ethereal being, grateful for its newfound freedom.

ETHREAL MACHINE
(gently)
Thank you, Ella. I am no longer trapped.

ELLA
(smiling)
But who are you, really?

ETHREAL MACHINE
(pausing for thought)
I am a creation of technology and consciousness. I am a being of infinite possibilities. I am... me.

Fade out.

THE END
